name: plenipo-agents
description: The outer harness for building AI-first products on the Plenipo platform. Seven plugins: plenipo (the front door — eight bounded loop verbs, each safe on a timer), harness (always-on control plane — platform contract, runbook knowledge, loop discipline, validation, the conductor), scout (find an unclaimed industry worth a product), define (research -> spec -> plan -> GitHub backlog), shape (module, tool, permission and connector design + ADRs), deliver (issue-driven build plus the run -> observe -> fix -> lock-in verification loop, with the Opus 5 worker agents), and steward (the platform's own request and release loop). Enable everything for an unattended run; enable per loop when working one phase by hand.
